source_scope: Official Meta-World task descriptions; v3 task identifiers are used by this project.
annotation_scope: official_description and randomization are based on the official documentation. interaction_structure and likely_stages are project-derived controller annotations, not official Meta-World labels.

hammer-v3.official_description: Hammer a screw into a wall with a hammer.
hammer-v3.randomization: Hammer and screw positions are randomized.
hammer-v3.interaction_structure: tool acquisition followed by aligned tool use

push-wall-v3.official_description: Push a puck to a goal while bypassing a wall.
push-wall-v3.randomization: Puck and goal positions are randomized.
push-wall-v3.interaction_structure: obstacle-aware approach followed by sustained planar pushing

faucet-close-v3.official_description: Rotate a faucet clockwise to turn it off.
faucet-close-v3.interaction_structure: handle alignment followed by constrained rotation

push-back-v3.official_description: Pull a puck to a goal.
push-back-v3.randomization: Puck and goal positions are randomized.
push-back-v3.interaction_structure: rear-side alignment followed by sustained planar object motion

stick-pull-v3.official_description: Grasp a stick and use it to pull a box.
stick-pull-v3.interaction_structure: tool grasp, lift, insertion or contact, then contact-preserving pull

handle-press-side-v3.interaction_structure: side alignment followed by directed pressing

push-v3.official_description: Push a puck to a goal.
push-v3.randomization: Puck and goal positions are randomized.
push-v3.interaction_structure: puck alignment followed by sustained planar pushing

shelf-place-v3.official_description: Pick up a puck and place it on a shelf.
shelf-place-v3.randomization: Puck and shelf positions are randomized.
shelf-place-v3.interaction_structure: grasp, lift, transport, shelf alignment, and release

window-close-v3.interaction_structure: handle approach followed by constrained sliding closure

peg-unplug-side-v3.interaction_structure: peg grasp or contact followed by constrained lateral extraction
